# FW-NNN: Future Work Title

> Replace every placeholder. Keep this capture small. It preserves an idea; it
> does not commit GiftUI to pursue it or authorize a design.

## Observation / Opportunity

State the idea, optimization opportunity, unanswered question, or postponed
decision in a few sentences.

## Why Deferred

Explain why this is not required or answerable in the current scope.

## Potential Value

- Possible benefit, stated as a hypothesis rather than a promise.

## Current Non-goals

- Work that this item does not add to the current milestone or source artifact.

## Revisit Triggers

- Concrete evidence, dependency, threshold, milestone, or event that should
  cause re-evaluation. Do not write only “later.”

## Disposition

Captured. On promotion or closure, record the destination or reason here and
update `status`, `updated`, and `promoted_to` as applicable.

## References

- Source artifact, implementation finding, issue, measurement, or code path.
